en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a railway station area with train tracks running toward the horizon. On the right stands a large multi‑storey station building with a tower-like corner and several smaller adjoining structures. Railcars and small buildings line the tracks on the left. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower margin and part of the upper margin. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.
